levels.title: PHP 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: Apply consistent indentation, clear naming, and official documentation so any team can read and audit the code in seconds.
levels.reference_solution:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Build a sanitized greeting message.
 */
function greet(string $name): string
{
    $clean = trim($name);
    return $clean === "" ? "Hello!" : "Hello, {$clean}!";
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

enum OrderStatus: string
{
    case Pending = "pending";
    case Paid = "paid";
}

/**
 * Typed order entity following PSR-12.
 */
final class Order
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly OrderStatus $status = OrderStatus::Pending,
    ) {
    }
}
